description: The bar chart illustrates the evaluation of ChatGPT versus other sentiment analysis algorithms by plotting their accuracy values. The category axis is horizontal, showing three labeled groups from left to right: “VADER,” “TextBlob,” and “ChatGPT,” and the value axis is vertical with the label “Accuracy,” displayed on a linear scale ranging from 0.4 to 1.0 with regularly spaced tick marks at 0.1 intervals. There are three single bars (one per category): the VADER bar is white with a black outline and reaches approximately 0.69 accuracy, the TextBlob bar is white with a black outline and diagonal hatch marks and reaches approximately 0.66 accuracy, and the ChatGPT bar is solid green and reaches approximately 0.94 accuracy. A legend inside the plotting area on the right identifies the styles for “VADER,” “TextBlob,” and “ChatGPT.” The bars are not shown as grouped or stacked beyond one bar per category, appear in the left-to-right order listed on the x-axis, and none are visually emphasized with annotations beyond their distinct fill and hatch styling.
